calculate_rmsd: calculate the RMSD between ORCA and MLIP optimized atom structures after minimizing rotation and translation
compute_interaction_energy_and_forces: compute interaction energy and forces for a supersystem like a ligand pocket from component results
evaluate_ligand_pocket: evaluate ligand pocket error metrics including energy MAE and interaction forces MAE between ORCA and MLIP results
evaluate_ligand_strain: evaluate ligand strain error metrics including strain energy MAE and global minimum RMSD between ORCA and MLIP results
evaluate_singlepoint: evaluate singlepoint energy MAE, energy per atom MAE, and forces MAE between ORCA and MLIP results
